name: Mir Post Reactions
author: mirmehranarjmand

sections.description:
Mir Post Reactions lets visitors react to WordPress posts with Like, Love, Laugh, Wow, Sad, Angry, and Dislike reactions.

Features include:

  • Fast AJAX reactions without page reloads.
  • Support for logged-in users and guests.
  • Users can change or remove their reaction.
  • Reaction totals and an admin overview.
  • Automatic display before or after post content.
  • Shortcode: [mir_post_reactions]
  • PHP function: mirpr_display_reactions()
  • Elementor widget support.
  • English as the default plugin language.
  • Persian (fa_IR) translation included.

Development

The JavaScript and PHP source code is included directly in this plugin package in human-readable form. No build tools or compilation steps are required to regenerate the distributed plugin files.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate Mir Post Reactions.
  3. Open Post Reactions > Settings to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
Can guests react?

Yes. Guest reactions can be enabled or disabled in the plugin settings.

Can a visitor change a reaction?

Yes. Selecting another reaction changes the previous one. Selecting the same reaction again removes it.

Is Elementor required?

No. The plugin works without Elementor. The Elementor widget is registered only when Elementor is active.

short_description: Add fast AJAX emoji reactions to WordPress posts with reports, shortcode, PHP function, and an Elementor widget.
